entities.summary: May Revolution, a transformative movement in Argentina (1806–1810). Emerged from British capture Buenos Aires — June 1806; reconquered by Liniers — August 1806 and Free trade regulation opens Buenos Aires port. Catalyzed Second British invasion repelled — July 1807 and May Revolution (Revolución de Mayo) — May 25, 1810.
